full_name: European Conference for Aeronautics and Space Sciences (now styled 'European Conference for AeroSpace Sciences')
organizer: EUCASS association (non-profit; European aerospace universities and research centres), with a local host per edition (e.g. 3AF in 2022, CEAS in 2023)
frequency: Biennial (odd years; 2022 and 2023 were back-to-back after the COVID shift)

submission.type: One-page A4 abstract (oral or poster); full paper for proceedings
submission.typical_abstract_deadline: Mid-January of the conference year (2025: 15 Jan; 2027: 15 Jan)
submission.typical_final_deadline: Proceedings deadline in mid/late June, just before the conference (2025: 25 Jun; 2027: 20 Jun)
submission.notes: Maximum of 3 papers per author; abstracts are uploaded as PDF through the website (https://eucass2027.eu/submission-guidelines/). 2019: abstract deadline 11 Feb 2019, extended to 10 Mar 2019.

editions.venue: ETSIAE-UPM School of Aeronautics and Space Engineering
SwissTech Convention Center, EPFL (joint 10th EUCASS - 9th CEAS, Aerospace Europe Conference 2023)
Scottish Event Campus (SEC) (per spaceagenda listing; not confirmed on official site)

notes: EUCASS 2027 is the 12th edition; the Call for Papers was issued 6 Oct 2026, and the eucass2027.eu banner said 'Submission now open' on 2026-10-16. 2027 key dates: notification 18 Mar 2027, proceedings deadline 20 Jun 2027. The 2027 venue (SEC) comes from a third-party listing only. 2023: registration opened 9 Jul, sessions ran 10-13 Jul and technical visits were on 14 Jul; the page listed a full paper deadline of 9 Jul 2023 but no abstract deadline. 2025: the venue comes from the space-innovation.ch event listing. No EUCASS edition was held in 2014; the 5th was Munich 2013. The 2019 abstract_deadline is the extended date; the original was 11 Feb 2019. Abstract deadlines for 2015, 2017, 2022 and 2023 were not found.
